messages:
ops-bot: ALERT: smart-fallback-v2 routing entered a rapid cross-region oscillation: us-east -> us-west -> eu -> us-east. Observed ~10m of probe flapping and elevated 5xx rates. PagerDuty: @mike is on-call. Incident INC-231000 created. link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-231000

mike: acknowledged, looking now. which customers impacted? any active Dedicated customers on these zones? :eyes:

ops-bot: Impact summary: small % of requests hitting fallback variant (quantized model) causing increased latency and ~1.2% 5xx for a subset of routes. A few enterprise customers in us-east reported errors. No full region outage.

jen: I'm on the routing stack. quick hypothesis: health checks for inference-worker instances in us-west are flapping and the smart-fallback policy immediately promotes other regions, which then fail their checks transiently and bounce back -> loop. Probably debounce config too low.

ahmed: can we throttle cross-region failovers? runbook suggests intermediate cooldown: /runbooks/fallback-loop.md

jen: yes. trying a temporary mitigation: increasing healthcheck failure threshold from 2 -> 6 and enabling a 30s cooldown for policy decisions. Applying now.

jen: command run:
```
# patch routing policy
redwoodctl policy set smart-fallback-v2 --hc-fail-threshold=6 --decision-cooldown=30s --dry-run=false
```

pagerduty-bot: @mike, escalation acknowledged. Paging the infra rotation for visibility.

mike: thanks. jen, keep updates in thread. I'll start customer comms draft and notify CS if any critical accounts. @paula you awake?

paula: up. I'll pull the customer impact list and start outreach for any enterprise customers that saw >1% errors.

jen: mitigation applied. Observed immediate reduction in flaps. graph: healthcheck-flap-rate dropped from ~18/min to ~2/min over 60s. routing short-circuits stopped.

ahmed: good. can you snapshot the policy state and save as rollback? also let's not leave cooldown permanently high; we need planned change.

jen: saving policy snapshot and creating a safe-rollback tag: `policy/smart-fallback-v2@inc-231000`

jen: saving command:
```
redwoodctl policy export smart-fallback-v2 > /ops/incidents/INC-231000/policy-snapshot.json
```

sre-oncall: telemetry shows p95 latency for affected routes is back to baseline within 3 minutes. 5xx trending down to normal. I'm keeping tracing hooks active for 30m.

mike: great. will we need a change to the health probe logic long-term? i'm thinking automatic debounce (sliding window) rather than fixed threshold.

ahmed: yes. proposal: move health-check evaluation to a sliding-window median + hysteresis, and apply a rate-limited promotion to another region. Draft config snippet below:
```
health_check:
  method: http
  interval: 5s
  window: 12   # 12 samples -> 60s
  failure_ratio_threshold: 0.3
  hysteresis: 2  # require 2 consec windows
  promotion_rate_limit: 1/min
```

jen: that looks good. filing follow-up RFC and a staged rollout to dedicated regions only. tagging infra @ahmed for perf tests.

paula: customer outreach: I sent notes to 3 enterprise contacts; two replied, one wants a post-incident summary. I'll coordinate with Mike.

mike: assigning postmortem to jen + ahmed. I'll draft the impact blurb for status page: short outage window, mitigation applied, next steps.

ops-bot: INC-231000 status updated: mitigated -> monitoring. Assigned: jen, ahmed. Postmortem requested.

jen: quick note for on-call handoff: leaving monitoring at default for 45m, will hand to next oncall. brief summary: temporary HC threshold increase fixed immediate loop; long-term change: sliding-window + rate-limit promotion.

mike: thanks. next oncall @ahmed, you'll take live watch for 45m then confirm.

ahmed: taking handoff. I'll keep the thread open for any regressions.

sre-oncall: confirmed no additional flaps in 20m. closing active page. :white_check_mark:

paula: noted, customers updated. will request technical summary for them after postmortem.

mike: closing notes: raise RFC priority, schedule a canary rollout next week, and let's add a synthetic test that simulates a noisy healthcheck to catch this. Great job triaging quickly. :thumbsup:

ops-bot: Incident INC-231000 archived as mitigated at ts 2310001845. Follow-ups: RFC-2345 (healthcheck debounce), postmortem-INC-231000.
